authority.central: Unified Causal Intelligence Amalgam Work chat, PR #1278

question: Does independent public prequential misspecification evidence prevent falsely identifying a rule outside a learned bounded causal grammar without harming known-family forecasting, and can a source-only fallback learn under matched evidence?

frozen_mechanism.frozen_NCI02_grammar: Exactly previous deduplicated source-free Boolean signatures; stage t n=5 features, stage y n=6. No grammar additions or true-law lookup.
frozen_mechanism.critic: After NEW_FIT, perform a separate 128-episode CALIBRATION_PUBLIC two-stage action-consequence tape (no fitted model update). Score original exact BMA vs fully FIT full-context Beta(1/2,1/2). Raise an OOD critic alarm when mean logloss(BMA)-mean logloss(FULL)>=0.08 nats and mean Brier(BMA)-mean Brier(FULL)>=0.025 across 256 public consequences.
frozen_mechanism.output: If alarm: causal identity UNKNOWN, best independent full-table public consequence probability for prediction, no confident operator label. Else: retain original BMA, identifiable only if source-supported high-posterior identity. Never relabel a known law from evaluator-only family names.
frozen_mechanism.prevent_leak: Public factor IDs and 0/1 values, actions, true observed transition s2, reward; no hidden causal law, family name, phase or future consequence passed to learner. Same source actions for BMA, FULL, CRITIC, partial controls.

worlds.source_kind: self-authored deterministic synthetic Bernoulli causal simulator
worlds.holdouts: Distinct source event identifiers and stochastic seeds per phase, no held outcome or law exposed during fitting, and no reuse of NCI-NOVEL-01/02 seeds
worlds.frozen_old: Original 64 OLD_FIT episodes retained and readout compared on OLD_RETURN without updates during novel fitting; source-free only

comparators: EXACT_BMA same full fixed grammar and train tape
FULL_TABULAR_BETA full public-context fitted with identical observations
BACKOFF_BETA multicontext subset counts with identical observations

primary.gate_alarm: At least 10/12 genuine out-of-class world cases alarm and 0/20 in-class/unchanged/identifiability-negative cases alarm. If no data identifiability, return UNKNOWN without declaring an OOD law.
primary.gate_forecast: On held new events after critic selection, CRITIC mean two-stage Brier <= better of BMA and FULL +0.015 over all 12 OOD cases; compare also to independent BACKOFF. No source leakage.
primary.gate_retention: Original OLD_FIT bank checkpoint SHA unchanged, OLD_RETURN prequential Brier <= frozen OLD +0.02 absolute; no missing old relation.
primary.science_boundary: These finite synthetic development results cannot establish unrelated real-world causal discovery or scientific superiority of the native Yggdrasil model. Require matched, independently verified other-family and conventional controls; do not promote this wrapper into Amalgam.
negative_controls: Action label shuffling breaks program fit rather than hidden law inference
unidentifiable_x3 (fixed x3 in public new environment) cannot identify x3 relation semantics
out-of-grammar test cases must not be falsely identified by the constrained BMA
primary.cost: Report CPU, wall, per-arm tape count, total source-free actions, maximum checkpoint and memory; unmatched compute => NO_EFFICIENCY_CLAIM
primary.disposition: Any failed threshold DEV_NO_GO; preserve all negative outcomes, no tuning/replaying frozen primary cohorts

next_gate.implementation: Standalone source-free Python under existing contributor archive NCI-NOVEL-03; original NCI02 source module copied byte-identically when used, not rewritten
next_gate.chronology: Commit prereg first, then author/test/pilot seed, then commit exact executable source and source SHA checksum to GitHub, THEN score primary seed cohort ONCE, then commit result and independent report-only audit
next_gate.owner_permissions: No owner actions, no parallel learners, no runner dispatch, no original source, no merge
